overview.description: The Vanguard Morningstar Growth ETF (VUG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund tracks an index of large-cap stocks in the US. Holdings are selected and weighed based on growth factors. VUG was launched on Jan 26, 2004 and is issued by Vanguard.
